summary: The filing is a Form 6-K by Patria Investments Limited, a foreign private issuer, reporting first quarter 2026 earnings results. It includes financial highlights such as $2.3 million net income, $50.5 million Fee Related Earnings, and $42.4 million Distributable Earnings ($0.27 per share). The company declared a quarterly dividend of $0.1625 per share payable June 11, 2026. The press release also discusses fundraising, AUM growth, and a bond issuance. No special-situation event — such as a merger, acquisition, spin-off, or activism — is disclosed. This is a routine periodic earnings release.
